subject.title: fix(zalo): prevent webhook message loss after acknowledgment

question: Can a maintainer provide or authorize a Zalo bot/account to verify live webhook delivery and restart redelivery before this durable-ingress change merges?
rationale: The shared-drain tests are substantial, but only a real Zalo webhook can establish that acknowledgement and provider retry behavior match the new persistence boundary.

options.title: Capture live Zalo proof
options.body: Use a maintainer-controlled Zalo bot to record successful delivery and accepted-message restart recovery before merge.

options.title: Accept rollout-only validation
options.body: Merge with the documented live-proof gap and explicitly own production rollout validation risk.

recommendation.title: Capture live Zalo proof
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer-controlled Zalo bot to record successful delivery and accepted-message restart recovery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the change and its PR body identifies the missing authorized Zalo validation path.
